edt_01.label: A Logbook from the Edge of the World
edt_01.editorial_notes: Open with the human image of volunteers logging birds on ships. Establish dataset scale (12,310 censuses, 49,019 species rows, 21 years) and geographic heart (Tasman Sea / Southern Ocean). Hero image of an albatross over the Tasman Sea sets the tone; chart is a small KPI/summary showing top-line numbers.

edt_02.label: What the Logbooks Could and Could Not Capture
edt_02.editorial_notes: Quality caveats: instruments missing in 90%+ of records but behaviour/location near-complete; 38.7% of records are taxonomic aggregates; 99,999 sentinel. Bar chart of missing-value rates by column makes the asymmetry visceral.

edt_03.label: Albatrosses by Encounter, Shearwaters by the Million
edt_03.editorial_notes: The two top-species rankings tell different ecological stories. Use a side-by-side or grouped bar chart contrasting top-by-records vs top-by-individuals; alternatively, a single chart showing top species with both metrics.

edt_04.label: The Geography of Effort
edt_04.editorial_notes: This is the section that needs the Leaflet map. Plot 5°×5° grid cells with circle markers sized by census count and coloured by total birds; centre on Tasman Sea (-40°S, 170°E). Latitude band breakdown reinforces the concentration.

edt_05.label: The Shape of Time: A Five-Year Pause and a 1980s Boom
edt_05.editorial_notes: Yearly bar/line chart of censuses 1969-1990 with the 1970-1974 zero gap clearly visible and the 1987 peak labelled. Brief mention of season balance and full-vs-partial protocol fidelity.

edt_06.label: Following the Ship: A Behavioural Fingerprint
edt_06.editorial_notes: The behavioural-profile heatmap (top 10 species x behaviour percentages) is the strongest visual here. An image of a wandering albatross trailing a ship's wake reinforces the 'entourage' framing.

edt_07.label: One Logbook, Twenty-Six Hands, One Dominant Voice
edt_07.editorial_notes: Close on the human story: 26 observers, J. Jenkins doing 53.5%. Horizontal bar chart of top observers. Brief mention of activity mix and weather/wind null result. Final paragraph reframes the dataset as a pre-bycatch-crisis baseline.
